items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: I go into John McKinney's Cotton Pickers in Detroit.

ctx.x: Because she wanted four rhythm and four sax with MacRae, and Dick Vance and myself, and Sleepy. So then we travelled around with her. Now, after I get to Detroit, I found out I don't like this, because we're not working regular enough and they're paying you pro rata. So we're not working regular enough, and so we get into the -- I go into John McKinney's Cotton Pickers in Detroit.
